name: dev.ucp.shopping.gift
title: Gift Extension
description: Extends Checkout with recipient-based gift purchases.

recipient_display.description: Merchant-approved buyer-facing presentation of a selected recipient.

name.description: Buyer-facing recipient name, relationship name, or other merchant-approved display value, such as 'Mom'.

recipient.description: Business-provided buyer-facing presentation of the recipient selected for a gift checkout. The Business remains authoritative for recipient identity, eligibility, and fulfillment details.

display.description: Buyer-facing presentation of the recipient, supplied by the Business. This is presentation data, not a verified identity or authorization credential.

gift.description: Gift checkout context. An empty object is a no-op; recipient-based gifting is requested by `recipient_required: true`.

recipient_required.description: When `true`, requests a recipient-based gift checkout. The Business MUST require a selected, eligible recipient before accepting Complete Checkout. This field does not prescribe how the Business collects recipient input.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Gift
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with recipient-based gift support.
